column1: # Fence ordering domains — GENERATED by tools/gen-fence-domains.py.
# The NAMES come from doc 01 §4 and are a human decision. The BITS are
# read back out of the assembler: each domain is assembled alone in the
# predecessor position and the field extracted. A bit assignment recalled
# from memory produces a valid fence that orders the wrong operations,
# and that does not fail — it races, sometimes, on another machine.
